English: At last, Dhaos' castle has revealed itself.
The moment of truth is at hand.

The hero's grand adventure
flashbacks through his mind.

With his friend, a master marksman
wielding a great bow by his side, he proceeds

toward the grand finale to sever the
chains of fate that bind his own hand.

You know, this narcissistic
narrating thing is getting old.
...Don't mind me, man. I'm just having fun.
